verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents several programmatic surfaces: the bq CLI for creating datasets, loading data and querying; the Storage Write API (gRPC); ODBC/JDBC drivers; a Rust SDK in Preview; Arrow-format result retrieval; and query-plan diagnostics embedded in query jobs. Nothing in the pack states that the API matches the UI, and UI-centric features such as data canvas, conversational analytics and data insights have no evidenced API equivalents. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API access to Gemini/canvas/conversational-analytics features, independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
